title: Wrapping up the AX for Good session
description: On the evening of Friday, July 24, 2026, I wrapped up the AX for Good session.

spans.text: On the evening of Friday, July 24, 2026, I wrapped up the AX for Good session.

So many leaders came. It was my first time, and I was really nervous, but everyone stayed focused to the end and joined in actively. I am truly grateful. My heartfelt thanks also go to Yukwaehan Banran, MYSC and Uniquegood Company for giving me such a great stage for my debut.

Earlier in the program, MYSC CEO Kim Jung-tae and Uniquegood Company CEO Song In-hyuk did a wonderful job of sharing how their companies have grown with AI as the AX era arrives. I followed with how to actually take that path, one step at a time: how to get meaningful results from today's most talked-about AI models, and beyond that, how Uniquegood Company puts AXIT to work every day. Then we all tried it out together!

During the session and afterwards, many people came up to say hello and ask serious questions. “Which AI model should we use?” “For an organization like ours, is it better to build a platform like AXIT ourselves, or to use one?” The questions took different forms, but underneath they shared the same concern: what should we choose? In an AI era like this one, here is the answer I want to give to all of them.

I think AX is AI Transformation, and at the same time, AI Experience. When AI gets better by the day, you cannot judge what you have not experienced. Rather than rushing to judgment, I recommend investing in that experience first.
I believe the answers to which model is best, and whether to build your own SaaS or use an existing one, also come from hands-on experience in the end.

Some people told me it was the most memorable and helpful workshop they had attended in a while. Every one of those kind words meant a lot to me. Thank you so much. Thank you for staying with us through such a long session, and I sincerely hope this event was a meaningful first step toward creating new social impact.
I will prepare the next part of this AX workshop and be back soon. Thank you!
